tasks.subject: Task 1: Help detection in FoundryCLIParser
tasks.description:
**Goal:** ParseResult reports help requests with the deepest command scope parsed so far; noun scope recorded on errors.

**Files:** main/cli_parser.h, main/cli_parser.cpp, tests/core/os/test_foundry_cli_parser.h

**Verify:** ./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-case="*FoundryCLIParser*"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["main/cli_parser.h", "main/cli_parser.cpp", "tests/core/os/test_foundry_cli_parser.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-case=\"*FoundryCLIParser*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["help flags anywhere set help_requested with correct scope", "help alias routes scope", "required-option validation skipped for help", "errors record noun scope"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Declarative help registry and text renderers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** main/cli_help.{h,cpp} registry (8 nouns, 17 commands) + text renderers for top/noun/command help, with tests.

**Files:** main/cli_help.h, main/cli_help.cpp, tests/core/os/test_foundry_cli_help.h, tests/test_main.cpp

**Verify:** ./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-case="*FoundryCLIHelp*"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["main/cli_help.h", "main/cli_help.cpp", "tests/core/os/test_foundry_cli_help.h", "tests/test_main.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-case=\"*FoundryCLIHelp*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["const char* static data only", "three-level text renderers with ANSI styling", "editor-only badge and build filtering", "no legacy option text"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Wire scoped help into Main and delete legacy help sections
tasks.description:
**Goal:** setup() dispatches scoped help before engine init; print_help delegates to registry; legacy sections deleted; errors print scoped help to stderr.

**Files:** main/main.h, main/main.cpp

**Verify:** full test suite + manual smoke (--help levels, exit codes, no legacy text)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["main/main.h", "main/main.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["top help shows nouns+globals only", "help exits 0, errors exit non-zero with stderr help", "legacy help machinery deleted"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: JSON help output
tasks.description:
**Goal:** --json + help emits schema v1 JSON (full or scoped), no header, compiled-in commands only.

**Files:** main/cli_help.cpp, main/main.cpp, tests/core/os/test_foundry_cli_help.h

**Verify:** doctest *FoundryCLIHelp* + `--json script format --help | python3 -m json.tool`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["main/cli_help.cpp", "main/main.cpp", "tests/core/os/test_foundry_cli_help.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-case=\"*FoundryCLIHelp*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["foundry_cli_help_version 1 with flat commands array", "scoping filters to one command", "clean stdout, no ANSI/header"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Anti-drift cross-check tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Doctest proof that every registry noun/command/option is honored by the parser.

**Files:** tests/core/os/test_foundry_cli_help.h

**Verify:** doctest *FoundryCLI*

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tests/core/os/test_foundry_cli_help.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-case=\"*FoundryCLI*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["nouns match is_new_cli_command, count pinned at 8", "every CommandSpec parses to matching command_path", "every documented option accepted"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Documentation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** doc/tools/foundry_cli.md documents help hierarchy, alias, exit codes, JSON schema v1.

**Files:** doc/tools/foundry_cli.md

**Verify:** pre-commit run --all-files

```json:metadata
{"files": ["doc/tools/foundry_cli.md"], "verifyCommand": "pre-commit run --all-files", "acceptanceCriteria": ["three help levels + alias + exit codes documented", "JSON schema example matches implementation"]}
```
